List of Pokémon by footprint

This is a list of Pokémon by their footprint according to the Pokédex. Only Pokémon up to Generation V have footprint data in the Pokédex, though Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl feature remade footprints for all Pokémon up to Generation IV.

Originally, Giratina was the only Pokémon to have different footprints between its forms. In Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl, this was extended to Deoxys, Cherrim, and Shaymin as well.

Pokémon with no footprints

These are Pokémon that leave no footprint. Most of them are those that live only in water, crawl, or are constantly levitating. There are 150 Pokémon in this group, one of which is an alternate form of Giratina.

Trivia

  • Tauros, Rapidash, Stantler, and Keldeo all have footprints shaped more like horseshoes than real hoof prints. Keldeo's horseshoe-shaped footprint is reversed, which may be related to its ability to fire water from its hooves.
  • Trapinch's original footprint looks almost exactly like its face, which suggests it might have been based on an impression made by its head instead of its leg.
  • Regirock's original footprint looks like Scarabaeus sacer, the sacred scarab beetle from ancient Egypt.
  • All Generation II glitch Pokémon have placeholder footprints with their index numbers embedded into them. This includes Pokémon index #252 (), #253 (), #254 (), #255 (), and #256 ().
